notes: DEC RIDER LC (Residential Service - Equipment Control), NC Ninth Revised Leaf No. 71, as filed as EXHIBIT 25 in E-7 Sub 1032 (footer 'Order dated ____' - this is the PROPOSED clean sheet, Aug 20 2024 stamp). hd 7770 bounds are pages 16-24: pp16-19 = clean Ninth Revised (transcribed); pp20-24 = REDLINE vs Eighth Revised (Rider PM -> LC), not transcribed (would duplicate/garble). The published ncriderlc-pdf.pdf referenced by scripts/recover_riderlc_incentives_nc.py is NOT present in the repo, and this copy's text layer is native and clean (not OCR-mangled), so it is a weak category-G sample; hd7380 is the better OCR-mangling case. All values are incentives (CREDITS) in a bordered table on p17; units dollars_one_time / dollars_per_year extend the base unit enum. Season mapping: 'Non-Winter' -> non_summer is imprecise (control season Apr-Oct); 'Winter' = Nov-Mar. Hour limits (60/45/15 hours, 4 hours/day, 30-36 battery events, 20% state of charge) are program parameters, not charges. Verified against rendered p17.
